recipes.name: Moroccan Pasta inspired by Peep Show
instructions: Rinse and dry canned garbanzo beans. Toss them in a bowl with olive oil and salt. Then spread them evenly on a parchment lined baking sheet and roast on 400° for 20-30 minutes or until brown and crisp. - 1 can of garbanzo beans - Salt - Olive oil
Transfer beans to a bowl and toss them with plain sweet paprika and set aside. - Sweet paprika

Start by putting some olive oil in a pan and sauté small diced onion, small diced pepper, and crushed clove of garlic. Let them sweat it out until fragrant and translucent. - Olive oil - 1 Small onion diced - 1 Small red pepper diced - 1 clove of garlic

Add cumin, smoked paprika, cayenne, and turmeric. Let these flavors get to know each other a little bit before adding canned whole tomatoes. - pinch of cumin - pinch of smoked paprika - shake Hefty of cayenne - Generous jostling of turmeric - 28 ounce can of whole tomatoes
Smash them up and stew them down for about 30 minutes until the harsh raw tomato flavor has gone away.
Thoroughly puree the tomato sauce in a high powered blender until extremely smooth.
Set aside about half the sauce in a small saucepan to keep warm and in the remaining half add feta cheese. Process to combine. - ½ cup feta cheese
Butter 2 ramekins and set aside. - Butter
Cook pasta or make your own (which you can learn how to do on Basics With Babish) and add pasta to the feta sauce. Toss to combine and twirl up some pasta into the buttered ramekins. - 1 Pasta
Using a fork and spoon, put the pasta to the sides, creating a hole in the middle. Then bake at 400° for 10 minutes.

Remove ramekins from the oven and run a small paring knife around the outside of the ramekin to loosen it. Crack an egg in each of the wells you created and place back in the oven to bake for 10-15 minutes until the whites are set but yolks are runny. - Eggs
Invert pasta in ramekin onto an interim plate while we start plating.
Spoon some of the non-feta sauce into a pool on the bottom of the plate and top with sautéed spinach. - Spinach
Place pasta with egg on top and add some of the garbanzo beans as a delicious garnish.
Add olive oil and crushed garlic to a saucepan. - Olive oil - 1 clove of garlic
Add spinach, salt and pepper, and cook to desired tenderness. - Spinach - Salt
